archetypes.name: cross-loop-parity
archetypes.rationale: The plan claims symmetric treatment of /design and /implement loops but their internal convergence machinery differs significantly (streak-based vs Part A/B/C); a plan-vs-evidence gap reviewer is needed to catch asymmetric nit-counting file resolution, exit-code semantics, and KV emission.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that the nit-exclusion logic described for `skills/design/scripts/plan-review-loop.sh` and `skills/review-and-fix/scripts/review-and-fix.sh` is genuinely symmetric in the plan. For each loop, check whether the plan resolves the nit-count from the correct accepted population file (`accepted-plan-findings.md` vs `accepted-findings.md`), uses the same awk pattern (`^- **Severity**: nit`), and derives `non_nit_accepted` the same way. Identify any asymmetry in KV emission (`NIT_ACCEPTED_COUNT`/`NON_NIT_ACCEPTED_COUNT`) — the design loop emits both to stdout and to the step3 result env; confirm the plan specifies equivalent emission for the implement loop or explicitly omits it with justification. Check whether the lookahead/snapshot-failure path in `/design` has a parallel in `/implement` Part A, and whether the plan's treatment of those paths is consistent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-sweep
archetypes.rationale: Removing a flag (--convergence-threshold) and env var (LARCH_DESIGN_CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD) requires finding every caller; the plan lists specific files but does not demonstrate a complete sweep, leaving missed call sites that would cause silent empty-string bugs or exit-2 unknown-option failures.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check whether the plan's scope list covers every file that currently passes `--convergence-threshold` or references `LARCH_DESIGN_CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD`. The plan lists `skills/design/SKILL.md`, `skills/design/scripts/test-plan-review-loop.sh`, `scripts/test-design-multi-round-integration.sh`, `scripts/test-design-structure.sh`, and `skills/review-and-fix/scripts/test-review-and-fix.sh` as callers — verify against the actual scope-files list that no additional scripts under `skills/`, `scripts/`, `docs/`, or `.claude/` pass this flag or reference this env var. Also verify that `CONVERGENCE_STREAK` removal is complete: the plan removes it from `/design` runtime files and test harnesses but check whether `skills/design/scripts/test-step3-review-cap.sh` or `skills/review-and-fix/` reference it in ways not covered by the plan's specific guidance. Flag any file in the scope list whose plan guidance says 'remove/adjust any `CONVERGENCE_STREAK` references' without citing specific lines, since vague guidance at a high-changed-line-count site is a gap. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
